app.title: Space Mission Design Game
app.tagline: Design a mission, launch it, and see exactly why it worked or failed.

soon.coop: Co-op for 2–4 players comes after the solo mode.
soon.arcade: Arcade comes after the science mode.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fullscreenIos: Fullscreen on iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen
settings.fullscreenNone: This browser has no fullscreen mode
settings.keys: Arrows or W S — move · Enter or E — select · Esc — back · M — sound · F — fullscreen

languageScreen.title: Language
languageScreen.note: The game is in English and Ukrainian.

server.waking: Waking up the mission server — this can take up to a minute…
server.unreachable: Mission server is not responding. Try reloading the page later.

coop.title: Co-op
coop.createHint: Create a room and send the link to friends: up to 4 players, each leads their own roles.
coop.createFailed: Could not create the room — co-op needs the mission server.
coop.shareHint: Send the link to friends. The room lives on the server for 6 hours without activity.
coop.rolesHint: Give your roles to friends or free them. A free role, or one of a player who is away, can be taken. One player may hold several roles.
coop.gone: Room {{code}} was not found: it expired or the server restarted.
coop.offline: No connection to the server — retrying…
coop.foreign: This is a {{role}} decision ({{owner}}). Take or ask for the role in the lobby.
coop.startBlocked: The {{role}} role is free — give it to someone in the lobby.

room.playerIdRequired: No player id — reload the page.
room.nameTooLong: The name is longer than 24 characters.
room.unknownSlot: That player is not in the room.
room.notMember: You are not in this room — join it in the lobby.
room.roleTaken: That role belongs to a player who is online.
room.noRole: You hold no role — take one in the lobby.
room.rolesFree: Every role needs an owner before the start.
room.notLaunched: The mission has not started yet.
room.tooMany: The server has too many rooms right now — try later.

advisor.title: Mission mentor
advisor.empty: Ask anything about your mission: why a check fails, what to change first, where a number comes from.

suggest.power: Why is there not enough power?
suggest.budget: How can I make the mission cheaper?

advisor.explainRequest: Explain this flight report: why did it end this way and what should I change?
advisor.error: No answer — the server is unreachable. Try again a bit later.
advisor.tooMany: Too many questions — try again in an hour.
advisor.questionTooLong: The question is longer than 500 characters.
advisor.historyTooLong: The chat is too long — reload the mission to start a new one.
advisor.playerIdRequired: No player id — reload the page.
